title: From Global to Granular: Revealing IQA Model Performance via Correlation Surface

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the robustness of Image Quality Assessment (IQA) models and metrics by constructing imbalanced subsets of datasets with varying Mean Opinion Score (MOS) distributions (e.g., unimodal, bimodal, trimodal) and measuring the variance and stability of correlation scores across these different distribution samples.
